text: Dissatisfied Purchase. The mirror quality is not very good. Would recommend a different product.  The mirror is similar to a baby toy

Nice sized mirror, but sadly the light doesn't work. I decided to try it out even thought there are mixed reviews regarding the light, sadly I was one of the people who couldn't get the light to work no matter hard I tried. Other than that, the mirror size is great
Returned due to assembly. For some reason it was almost like the two parts weren’t made for each other, I couldn’t get the suction to connect to the actual mirror. Returned
Doesn't work. Came with batteries. Doesn't work. Changed the batteries on both the remote and mirror. Still doesn't work
Vibrates and moves too easily. This mirror is too easily moved. I know it’s supposed to move. But it vibrates and moves around while I’m driving. I feel like it’s more of a distraction than anything
Doesn't keep desired angle to see baby. We installed the mirror on the headrest of the seat but the mirror falls on the adjustable ball point and does not keep its angle

Flimsy garbage. Doesn't secure tight to the head rest, not convex enough so its hard to see from the rear view mirror forcing the driver to have to turn around to see. Great concept but poor execution

Defective.. The good: The mirror itself is great and attaches easily, and adjusts to where I need it to see my baby. The product includes batteries so you're ready to install.

The bad: The lighting did not work at all. I changed the included batteries and triple checked to make sure they were installed correctly - no dice. The remote itself was showing it did have power. No clue if the lighting function was defective or the actual remote. It looks like I'm not the only one with this issue as well.

Do not recommend if you need a mirror that has a light function

This Didn't Work for Us at All!. Try as I might, I could never get the mirror to stay on. It was a nightmare. I finally gave up when it hit my kid in the head. I was never able to see my child in the mirror, bc it kept falling off. Very frustrating! Cheap options are only great when they work. Definitely returned it!

Car mirror is self explanatory. Light was DOA.. This baby mirror works only so far as non-electrical parts. Anything electrical with it came completely nonfunctional. It still largely works for me because it's got the baby mirror and it's fairly hard to mess that up, but one of the key factors that drove me toward this was the light. Unfortunately with the lights already kaput, it serves no purpose beyond that of any other baby mirror.

That said, the most feasible place for the remote is directly in the garbage. The swivel is manual mechanical so it's not like it'd do anything for that.

Also, I get that the remote is super simple, but if it's possible I missed something with it, the whole unit never came with instructions. So I'm going on the assumption that there isn't a "trick" to it and I do believe it's simple
Not the best... I ended up returning it because the mirror came cracked and it wouldn’t latch onto the holder. Kind of a disappointment honestly
Weak straps and swivel. This doesn't stand the test of time. The swivel is weak and ends up pointing the mirror at the ground. And the straps don't tighten so the mirror flops around
Arrived broken :(. Im sure the Mirror surface is Shatterproof, but product arrived broken :(
Garbage mirror moves all the time. Hate that it keeps moving and we need to adjust it back. Waste if money horrible product

Practically useless. I had a cheaper version without lights that had no issues. This one will not stay on or stay level for anything. The horizontal strap across the headset pops off no matter what I do. The light feature is cool in theory, but really just creates glare. Also it dies quickly and is a hassle to detach to charge it. I truly regret buying this and can barely even use it as just a plain mirror
DISTORTED! Don’t Buy!!!. This is a cheap mirror that is distorted all around the edges. Like a play mirror. Do not waste your money
Clear mirror, cheap product.. The mirror itself it nice and absolutely clear as day. However one of the cheap buckles broke the first time I installed it
Broken after a year. We loved this at first, but after a year, it has fallen apart and the mirror part is loose from the base. Wish it would have lasted more than a year!!

Cheaply made, plastic mirror was already scratched up while lying in the closet. It's a cheaply made plastic mirror. Just installed it, which was easy. But it's already all scratched up just from lying in the carseat in the closet

Arrived without an essential piece. This mirror arrived without the swivel piece that is necessary to install it. So basically the entire thing is unusable because we cannot connect the strap to the mirror. The mirror looks to be a good size but have not been able to actually use it

Faulty product, nonexistent customer service. When this mirror stopped functioning and became a safety hazard, I reached out to the company about their lifetime guarantee. However, they are only “accessible” through e-mail and never responded to my multiple attempts to reach them. I would not purchase anything from this company again

The base breaks. I ordered it to to keep an eye on my baby but the mirror seemed shaky, when I checked, I discovered that the base of the mirror was broke and didn’t hold it in place.
I am glad I found this before it fell off on my child

Slowly falls down while driving. Mirror is large but heavy so the adjustable part can't hold the mirror. Driving around causes the mirror to slowly fall downwards and needs to be adjusted frequently. I do not suggest buying this

Shakes all over the place.. The mirror shakes while driving. No matter how tight I get the mirror on the headrest, it shakes all over the place while driving.

Our other brand doesn’t have this problem.

I wouldn’t recommend this product

Way too shaky. This product has a great concept, but I returned it. It shakes way too much when you are driving down the road that you can't even see your baby. I was really excited about this because it is nice in size and you can move it to different positions, but when you can't see the your baby what's the point of having the mirror

Vibrations violently even on smooth roads. Installation was fine but it vibrations violently even on smooth roads. This is our third mirror and the only one to ever vibrate and shake. Design flaw and not resolvable. Maybe ours was faulty given all the good reviews

Mirror won't stay in position - received a defective mirror. Mirror wouldn't stay in position. Every time we went over a bump it would point downward to where I can't see baby anymore. Not a way to tighten it so it stays up. Upon closer inspection, when I removed the mirror part, came to find out it's broken where the mirror attaches to the part that goes on the head rest. I think I'm now outside the return timeframe, so stuck with a busted mirror. Was delivered on baby's due date but bc I had a c section I wasn't driving for a few weeks. Should've checked the product as soon as I received but was busy before baby arrived

Vibrates too much. This product is great in theory but in actuality it falls short. The pivot feature was a selling point for me, however once installed I learned very quickly that this feature is this products downfall. It causes the mirror to vibrate with the motions of the car, making it nearly impossible to see what my baby is doing in the backseat. Not sure if it would be more stable in a different vehicle, but it definitely didn’t work for me.
That being said, the mirror is very easy to install, is quite sturdy, and has a nice aesthetic design to it so it does have that going for it

Breaks SO easily :(. Second time this mirror has broken so easily. First time I was trying to adjust it gently and it snapped off. Got a replacement the first time and now I’m out of luck. Second time, I slightly bumped into it and it broke right off. After you pop the mirror on, it can so easily break off, it’s so frustrating. It should be able to pop off, but instead just completely splits and that’s the end of it. I really liked the clarity of the mirror, but it has now broken twice on me so easily that I have no choice but to move onto a different brand
Suck. Mirror keep falling
Not able to see anything without light. Hard to see front front Mirror looks pretty dark unless there’s plenty of sun light otherwise you can’t see anything at all
Scratches easily. I have not even used this mirror yet, and the  plastic front mirror is already so scratched that it can't be used.  Very disappointed for not even using it

Its always 2 pieces. Passenger side mirror will be falling because the person will knock it off.. There's a magnet holds the mirror to the base. When I saw that I thought the passenger would constantly knocking the passenger mirror, & it would constantly be on the floor

It moves and you cannot see your baby. I have never been able to watch my kid in this mirror for more than 5 minutes. THIS IS NOT A STEADY MIRROR. It moves and shakes!!! The point of the baby mirror is to be able to see your kid. THIS IS NOT A GOOD BABY MIRROR

Bracket poked through back after one month. It was great until the bracket went through the back and no longer held the mirror up. It remained on the seat in position then must have just worn through because it was just hanging one day and I couldn’t make it go back up. Very disappointed with it. Would have been a great mirror if it had a better set up for the arm and bracket. Only was useful for a month

Sent incomplete product, customer service unresponsive. Waste of money!. I purchased this in May 2020, but I was sent only the mirror and strap piece, not the swivel mount. Hence, it's pretty much useless as it is, being unable to mount the mirror to the strap. I have sent several emails to Zacro since then, and they have never responded.

VERDICT: I recommend purchasing a mirror from ANOTHER BRAND, one that will send the complete product and one that actually provides customer service.

If Zacro responds, I will update my review accordingly
DOES NOT STICK ON WINDSHIELD. This mirror worked for a month, and now will no longer stick on my windshield no matter what I try

Keep moving every single time!. I hate this mirror so much. It keeps moving every time I put my kid in. I have to adjust every single time. It gets so annoying that I have to throw it away. Do not buy this one
Big and clear but shakes.. This mirror shakes constantly while driving. If it didn't do that it would be great

Keep looking..... Awful. Installed easy except for mirror does not lock in position.  Moves with each and every bump.. We live on country roads and the 10 minute drive into town the mirror isn't even in carseat's general direction let alone able to see my child. I ended up buying long velcro strips and rigging it for it to work. Definitely not attractive not but at least functional. Buy a different one

View of child during an EARTHQUAKE!!. Child is not easy to see and mirror is very shaky with no way of tightening it. Unfortunately I purchased it before baby arrived so I missed the return window. Not sure what to do with it now since I've ordered a replacement :(

Shaky, garbage compared to other brand. Personally I think this thing is garbage.

I have two kids so two mirrors. One mirror I've had for 2 years. Then this one. For the first week I liked this one better - it was like double the size of my first one. But after about a week it became loose at the joint and not shakes profusely.

The original one I have is rock solid and to be honest, although smaller it is plenty big. I'd rather have a small, stable mirror than a big, shaky mirror

Don't buy. Always falls down. Can't use. Not safe.. I bought two of these. Don't buy. It doesn't hold in place at all. The mirror pops off the attachment that is supposed to hold it in place CONSTANTLY. Like one bump on the road or a turn and the mirror falls down, which can also be very dangerous if it hit baby in the face. So disappointed. The one I had before was the diamond brand, nothing special but it actually did the job right

Want to love this, but can't afford to.. I've bought three of these now, and as much as I love the size and visibility, every one has had the arm for the bracket break through the back of the mirror. I'm not sure if it's just because I'm extended rear facing and my kids can reach with their feet, but it's only a piece of foam that supports the back. I really wanted to love these, but I cannot justify replacing every couple months

Buy something else. While I like the idea of this mirror being able to tilt and rotate, it's not at all secure. The mirror will fall and twist while driving because of how it's designed. So even though the back piece is secured fully to the seat and the mirror portion is clicked securely into the back piece, the mirror becomes unusable
Breaks easily. The attachment piece that holds the mirror is very fragile and has broken so our mirror no longer holds up. It's too late for us to return so we are stuck with a broken item

Constantly Repositioning. I purchased this mirror based on the reviews but I wish I would have went with something else. The ball in the socket on the back is not a tight fit so the mirror moves a lot while driving. If I drive over any bump, like a pothole, speed bump or even turn hard, the mirror shifts. Everytime I put my son in the car, I have to readjust the mirror which is a huge pain
It's so big and hard to put together, not worth it at all. It's so hard to put on and it's gigantic, it's a safety hazard for a driver, it's like a giant mirror it's crazy

Mirror Bounces and Shakes. This mirror is too shaky. It bobbles all over the place. It also sticks out very far from the headrest.
I bought this before we needed it and now it is past the time to return, or I would!

Breaks easily. This would be a great mirror, unfortunately the back broke a couple months in and the mirror was wobbling like crazy until we glued it back together. Not very withstanding to be taken on and off

Just ok. The mirror is really easy to put together and to install. I have twins and bought 2, the first time I used them my sons dropped and I could only see his legs but my daughters was fine. I thought maybe he pushed the mirror down with his feet but after moving it back up and watching it did it again after only a few minutes of driving

Seems decent enough. UPDATE:
Returning this. There is no way to tighten the mirror and as you drive, the weight of the mirror keeps pulling it down until you can’t see your babies face anymore.
A simple fix would be to make it a tightening nut, where the mirror attaches in. Not sure why that wasn’t added.
2 stars because it’s a nice wide and clear mirror of the baby.

Seems pretty decent, especially for the price.
The reflection is large and clear.
My only concerns are: will it start to sag over time? And the image is a bit distorted due to the convex nature (and quality of manufacturing) of the mirror
Poorly made. The product seems okay but is poorly constructed and cracked after a week of use. I was adjusting the mirror and the plastic snapped off. No way to repair it so in the trash it went
Doesn’t work. Not a good mirror, it’s bulky and moves all over the place. We returned it

It’s okay. I have a love hate relationship with this item. It gets the job done. The mirror zooms in but when you position the mirror it moves if you hit a small bump or if you turn the corner. I find it aggravating that I would be driving down the road and look into my rear view mirror and I can’t see my baby. Then finding a safe place to pull over to fix it
Shakes. My mirror rattles. I tightened it as tight as possible and it still shakes. Not sure why. Trying to contact the seller and I can’t find a way to do it
Wouldn’t recommend. The mirror was installed properly but has fallen off twice. Threw it away and bought a different brand and that one has worked perfectly
Cheap garbage. Garbage. Plastic snapped where the mirror attaches to the base after a few weeks of use. Now it just dangles uselessly
Bouncing to much. This product bounces. You look in your mirror to see your child and it just shakes. I’ve tried everything and it just keeps bouncing
Breaks easily. Super easy to install but what attaches the mirror to the holder snapped within the first year on my husbands and also on mine. I’m not happy with this product

Buckles Are Bad. I wish I returned this but I needed a mirror and it was crazy with a new child.  The mirror is fine.  The buckled on it are the worst.  One broke immediately.  The other doesn’t unclasp.  It seems money was invested on the mirror design but very little was put into the parts that hold the mirror to the seat

Mirror shakes. Unfortunately this mirror did not work out for us. It does not lay flat against head rest and shakes when you drive. We’ve tried to tighten it against the seat with little luck. We will be purchasing something else

Mirror shakes. Unfortunately this mirror did not work out for us. It does not lay flat against head rest and shakes when you drive. We’ve tried to tighten it against the seat with little luck. We will be purchasing something else

Not worth the money. The only thing good about the mirror was it was relative simple to install (even though the directions are pretty much useless).  The issue I have with it is that it’s so cheaply made that while I’m driving I can hear and see the mirror moving/rattling.  Spend the extra money and get a good one from the baby store - those are quiet and the mirror is bigger

Good but not good.. Product worked for what it was supposed to do, mirror was clear and kept a nice zoom on the baby.
Major con is the straps used to keep the mirror in place tend to loosen and the mirror becomes useless until you re adjust them again. This can be quite the hassle. It could just be my headrest but that’s my hot take
Unstable. Product moves around and is unstable.  I have to reconfigure the mirror multiples times per day

Looking for another one. Mirror itself was clear but man this thing would constantly move around even after tightening. It gets knocked around too easily that I’m surprised I kept it so long before tossing
Shakes and cannot see my child. Mirror is clear but shakes so much, even though installed correctly and securely, that I cannot even see my child while driving

Not Durable. It was easy to use and adjust and is a helpful item. However, your child will be in a rear-facing seat longer than this mirror will last. The tabs holding the mirror in place against that base broke (was able to reattach the mirror with a self-tapping screw). Also, the mirror needed to be readjusted every couple of months
Too big. Mirror is too large

Poor visibility. Mirror quality not good, shrank and centered my child’s head way too much to center of mirror. I could almost not see her. Need to dial in magnifying power and bend, through accurate engineering
Doesn’t hold position, falls down. This mirror constantly falls down and does not hold its position rendering it useless as I am not able to see my baby in the mirror while driving
Doesn't last!. Product doesn't last too long and is poorly made. We purchased two of them a few months ago and have had to replace them with a different product. I wouldn't recommend this mirror

Horrible rattling noise!!!. Is it a fluke that I got one that doesn't rattle?! I was so happy to find a mirror that was large and I could easily see my little one, so I ordered another one for baby #2... I requested a replacement after it installed it and it rattled terribly! Installed the new one and it rattles just as bad. Now I’m wondering if the rattling is a fluke or the sturdy non rattling one I got initially is the fluke?! Thinking of returning both and finding something new all together

Broke after a couple months. This baby mirror worked great for the first couple months. But then the mirror randomly fell off the connector piece, and now it’s outside the return time frame. No matter how many times we try to put the mirror back on, it falls right back off
Shakes. You figure something that is somewhat mounted would be sturdy, but in 3 different vehicles this mirror shakes so much. I don't even know where it is because I refuse to use it

Not worth the money. I drive a GMC Acadia with head rests that are supposedly compatible with this product. After securely installing the mirror, it still shakes while driving. Not impressed and don't recommend this product

Shakes like crazy. I’m returning mine, unfortunately. No amount of tightening the straps made this mirror stop shaking constantly. It’s super annoying to look at, and I would think it might give a baby motion sickness. I honestly don’t understand all these positive reviews because it’s obvious the ball joint is just too loose (with no way to tighten it down once you have the mirror positioned). And my car is BRAND NEW and rides very smoothly. I’m now seeking out a mirror that straps directly to the headrest without the adjustable feature
Great for paralell parking and not getting rim rash but adhesive does not last.. Work great until the entire mirror fell off while driving.  Only had it for 2 weeks

Not recommended. This blind spot mirror Damages quickly and become apart from the base with simple cleaning by cloth. If you install it without base it will stick at the mirror. But the base round ball is not stable
Cheaply made. Cheap . It came scratched and the mirror itself is very blurry
Terrible. Terrible mirror. Shakes while driving and moves when you go over bumps
Concave back. What good is a product that has a back that is concave and the adhesive tape supplied will not adhere the full length of the mirror?  Not much
It’s like a toy mirror. Doesn’t work

Not very helpful. I am a fan of convex mirrors. I've used them for years to check blind spots and clearance. The wide-angle works well on these mirrors but to the sacrifice of the traditional downward view. For me, the extra width of view is not worth the loss of up close and downward viewing from a traditional round convex mirror. Had I known, I would not have purchased
Not great. Not a very good quality mirror
Dark mirror. I can’t see my baby from driver seat, too dark. My baby can’t see me too. He’s cries only when he’s by himself at the back coz mirror is helpful

Fragile ropes / disintegrated by the sun. I love the idea of the mirror and being able to see my 4 month old but I guess from being in the sun is made the ropes break and disintegrate. Very disappointing
Mirror. Got the mirror and tried to install it..... it broke immediately
NOT sturdy. Mirror began to get loose after 3 weeks . Almost fell on my 2 month old son while driving . Glad I had passengers to catch it as it began to fall

Not safe. Do not buy.. From the time I received it, this mirror would Not keep it’s positioning. The mirror also would shake a lot while driving and the straps against the head rest would loosen. I was ok with all these issues but the other day, while I was driving, the mirror broke and fell!!  Luckily my infant wasn’t with me. It would’ve landed right on him. Do not buy this product. It is not safe
Shop around.. The mirror continues to slide down on the headrest after multiple adjustments and tightening. I thought it was pricey and wouldn’t buy again

Worked for a few days. The mirror did not hold up at all in the summer heat. Immediately started to dip down so that all I could see was the baby's legs. The ball part where the mirror sits does not look like it can be tightened therefore mirror is essentially useless since it will always fall back down and not show the baby's face. Would not recommend, sending in for a return.

Pros, mirror was very clear.
Negatives, I can't see the baby

Too shaky. Do yourself a favor and spend five bucks more for a decent mirror.

I cheaped out with this one and it shakes so much that it slowly lowers as you drive. The mount between the mirror and the plate with the straps is just too loose.

I’ll probably end up trashing this one and buying a different brand

Easy to install, doesn’t last long.. It was great for the first 4 months then the mount wore out and no longer held the mirror in place. Small bumps, including speed bumps would make the mirror angle downwards A LOT, as a result I could no longer see my baby in the mirror. This was especially frustrating during long car rides, which defeated the purpose of having a baby mirror. Customer support said this was normal? Not happy with the product anymore
Not a good baby Mirror. Can not adjust to a level, lowers down sometimes comes off

Distorted mirror. At first glance when the mirror is in your hands it appears clear/normal. Once you hook it up and view it from the drivers seat, the mirror is distorted like a “fun” mirror which is quite annoying. I tightened the back of mirror to the seat head the best I could, it still moved during rides. I have to fix it each car ride to make sure it’s in frame. The mirror size is perfect, although the product is overall disappointing

Mirror shakes out of position.. As we drive the mirror slowly shakes down with the regular idle of the car and I end up only seeing feet. I drive a 2017 Kia Sorrento, so it’s a fairly smooth ride, I was a little disappointed in the product

Position moves in transit. This mirror was fine the first couple of months, but now it moves with each little bump. 10 minutes into a drive and it is pointed down so I can no longer see the baby. Very frustrating not to be able to tell if the baby is asleep or not.  Looking for a new mirror now
Iffy. My mirror was cracked and even if it wasn’t cracked, the mirror is not tight enough so it sags!

Buyer beware: unsafe, poor customer service. I registered for this backseat mirror as part of my Amazon baby registry. It worked great for almost a year, and then the straps completely unraveled one day, rendering this product unsafe. I'm sure it's due to the intense sun and hear of living in Alabama, however customer service for this product is non-existent. I have emailed the company from a contact address in their website and received no answer. My second attempt was returned as an invalid email. Their listing states 100% guarantee/refund, but don't count on it. I also found this mirror to be rather large and bulky, but it suited our needs at the time. I would not purchase again
Pass on this one. ‘‘This  mirror sticks out very far compared to others. It also has to be so far up on the headrest to be useful. It impedes view out the back window then
Paid more for a softer fabric one. Returned bc it was too hard and clunky. Made me nervous it would come loose during an accident and hurt the baby. Got a soft fabric mirror instead but paid more
Schmooey image, returning.. The mirror is not clear enough that it provides any real look at my baby. I can make out that it's him and see colors. But the image is schmooey.... Foggy? Schmooey

Lasted 2 months. This lasted only 2 months for us before the swivel clip became too loose to hold up the mirror.  Even while it was still working for us, it constantly needed to be adjusted.  The slightest nudge while strapping in the baby moved it out of place

Cheaply made. We bought one of these and it got broken almost immediately. The back of it is made poorly. If any pressure is put on the mirror the back will bust through. We went through two of these in no time

Infant safety class instructors deemed this type of mirror to be unsafe.. We ended up returning the mirror because in our infant safety class they said looking at your child and then looking back at the road took two seconds to get refocused. They considered these types of mirrors to be safety hazards

Flimsy back plastic will break. The back plastic the goes on headrest is too thin and broke now the mirror is flimsy and doesn't hold position. I do not suggest buying this. The bands also leave marks on headrest if leather
Unstable—Shakes Regularly. The mirror constantly shakes regardless of how tight you adjust the straps
DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!!. This has to be the worst item I have ever purchased!!! The mirror does not fit onto the ball no matter how hard I try! If it would allow I would give zero stars!!!
Doesn't provide a good view of child. I found that I couldn't see my child clearly enough, with this mirror, she looked farther away than she actually is
Objects in mirror look much much much smaller than they appear.. Objects in mirror look much much much smaller than they appear
junk!. Mirror fell off almost as soon as it was out of the box!
It’s cheap. It wobbles to much and we pulled it so tight it was denting the headseat on a brand new vehicle.  The mirror is also not clear

Defective?. The mirror is really nice and reflects perfectly but my mirror shakes like crazy when I’m driving. I’ve tried readjustment but it still shakes. I don’t know if this is the way it’s supposed to be. If it is I would’ve bought a different mirror

Shakes and slides. A good size and clear mirror but I have to constantly adjust it. No matter how tight I make the straps it's always sliding down. Also tends to shake a lot while driving. Should have bought a non- pivoting mirror instead

Defective. Received this mirror and it was defective. The mirror comes with a suction cup and a clip, allowing you to choose the one you want to use in your car. But the ball joint was much too large to snap into place on both the clip and the suction cup, rendering it completely unusable. Very funny!

Constantly falls out of place - distracted driving hazard. Before going anywhere, you will need to re adjust the mirror, and at every stop light, it is properly secured but it constantly falls out of place and causes distracted driving. Invest in a good mirror, it is worth the extra money!

DO NOT BUY...unless.... No good. This mirror is big and looks good, BUT it’s the equivalent to a bobblehead. The mirror shakes, wobbles, and bounces. The design is poor. It constantly moves while driving and is frustrating. Whoever thought this was a good idea needs to sell bobble heads. Do not buy unless you like a mirror of your baby bouncing and vibrating
Views too small. Views too small . Need to adjust the rear mirror to fit it in when I wanna check out my baby

Poor strap quality - feels very unsafe. It’s a nice big mirror but the quality of the straps are terrible! Very light thin straps that seem highly unlikely to hold up to the force of an impact. The one of the buckles is also permanently stuck after the very first use. It seems like we will have to break it to unbuckle it. Very disappointed for the price
Didn’t come with all parts or broken. Mirror does not fit the ball on either of the Attachments for auction or visor

Not good for toddlers, didnnot hold up long. This product functions fine as a mirror but I realized that my toddler who is rear facing just kicks it all over and I can’t see him. In theory  it’s good that it rotates because there’s lots of Room to adjust it where you need it, but that also means that a toddler can just kick it out of place and it never ends up working. This isn’t an issue for my newborn though. Also this product has 2 peices; a base that you buckle onto the headrest on your car and then the mirror that clicks into the base. I bought two of these and on both of them, the part that allows it to click or secure into place got bent and the mirror is no longer secure in the base. It just kind of hangs and falls out easily which is dangerous. It only took less than two months for this to happen

Didn’t last even a year before falling apart. Bought this mirror about 10 months ago in anticipation of my first baby arriving. The first 5-6 months we used it, it was fine. But then it started to fall apart. The pivot point lost its friction hold, so it wouldn’t maintain the angle I needed it at to make it usable. At one point, I went to tighten the strap bc it had loosened over time, and the strap just broke off. The final straw was last night when I was driving home from work and the entire mirror fell from the headrest onto my baby. She was rather perturbed and I’m annoyed that it didn’t even last a year. Wouldn’t buy this again.

Update (10/15/2018): the kind customer service at Zacro reached out to me after I posted the above review, and offered to send me a replacement. They followed thru on their word and I received my replacement this week. I’ll try it out and see if maybe the original one was just a lemon, or if they all fall apart. I’ll update again in a few months, and consider modifying my rating then.

Side note: their customer service rep was wonderful to work with, and easy to communicate with!
Mirror offers a good view. However. Mirror offers a good view.  However, it does not hold in place well so I am constantly having to readjust it
Ok mirror bad straps. The mirror is ok easy to assemble and adjust. However the straps are made of low quality material when exposed to the sun they break

The mirror shakes when you drive.... I struggle with this.

What I love -
The size is great. My wife has one she bought at Walmart that doesn't tilt, but is padded and straps directly to the headrest. The downfall of hers is how small it is, makes it hard to see our child. I decided to get this one for the size. It's size is perfect. I notice my child can easily see me as she does give me eye contact.

What I hate -
It shakes. Any sort of bump in the road and this thing shakes. You have to realize it's on an arm. That tilt function you think you really want? Well it's not entirely a great thing. It doesn't matter how tight you have it strapped to your headrest, or how tight you make the ball joint. IT WILL SHAKE. It's simply too long to keep stable.

If I were you, I'd be looking for something without the arm to reduce the shake/vibrations.

Shows a lot of promise, but not quite there.. After using a video baby monitor from another manufacturer for the past two and a half years, we decided we wanted to try something new for our next child. Things we were looking to improve on were battery life, audio reception, and dual camera support.

After hours of research, we decided to purchase the Eufy SpaceView. Immediately upon unboxing, you'll notice the packaging is very detailed and modern. It gives the initial 'feeling' of quality (compare to unboxing an Apple or Nest product).

PROS:
- Clean, modern design.
- Large, high definition display.
- Battery life (Presumed - no long term testing)
- Audio sensitivity

CONS:
- Monitor feels delicate
-- Antenna is long and flimsy
-- Kickstand is offset and flimsy (though Eufy confirmed it's offset to allow a larger battery)
-- Large screen makes me 'think' I shouldn't just throw it in a pocket or bag
- Can only mount the camera with the included corner mount (I've read a flat wall mount is available - cannot confirm)
- Standalone camera is not yet available for purchase after months of delays
- Dark colors show as purple in naturally lit rooms

I've been in contact with customer service on a couple of issues, and while they are responsive, it feels very startup-esque. For one, the firmware update is through a YouTube video link to a Dropbox account. Some of the dialog I've had and what I've read of other reviewers interactions, is that they'll get right into the technical details and try to resolve your issues with software updates. Cool to have that type of one-on-one resolution ability, but not really the journey I'm looking to go on with a toddler at home and a new baby due any moment.

All in all, I think Eufy is a promising company with a promising product in the SpaceView, but it's not ready for mainstream just yet. If you're an early adopter and can ride out a few quirks, I think this may be a great option for you. For us, it ultimately ended in a return and we're going with another option that has a longer track record.

[June 2019 Update]: Eufy has been absolutely amazing to work with. They followed up upon return of the monitor to gather feedback and see what they could do to make my experience better. They're highly responsive and open to honest feedback. They've even set me up with the latest 'S' version which fixed the purple issue mentioned above, comes with a crib / flat wall mount, and has a stand alone monitor coming out in just a few weeks. While my review of the product itself does not change, it's worth noting how Eufy's customer service goes above and beyond on a personal level

(3) The wide angle lens is in no way for a room shot at night. Daytime yes, but if the room is dark you will not be able to see your children whatsoever. The frame around the camera is fuzzy from the moment the wide angle lens is put on the camera.
(4) In order to get the camera to function WITHOUT the wide angle lens in a room where there are two beds, it should be up no higher than 4.5 feet and NOT attached to the wall. Camera Two

The wide angle is also fine because its 3ft away from the subject, but I don't understand why anyone would want a wider shot of a crib when the one (non-wide angle lens) works totally fine for that.

Camera Three

Good... Until It Breaks Shortly After.. I purchased this monitor 11/27/2019. I didn't start using it until some time in the spring of 2020 when I installed it in preparation for our baby. The monitor has great picture quality, and compared to our previous monitor (one of the more highly recommended ones on Amazon), it has clear night vision and sound.

However, the monitor started getting staticky at the start of January 2021. It's important to note that this happened on its own (no damage on my or my family's part since we use it only during our children's nap/sleep and keep it out of reach from them). I contacted Anker/Eufy on 1/16/2021. The company provided different troubleshooting tips, but nothing worked. Because I was out of my 12-month warranty window, but as a one-time courtesy, the company shipped a refurbished monitor to me, which I received early February (I didn't receive tracking info, so I don't have an exact date for that, but I do have email records to show this).

I started using the refurbished monitor, and it worked great! Fast forward to the end of June 2021/start of July 2021 the sound stopped working, and I also was unable to switch/shuffle through the different cameras that are set up. I contacted Anker/Eufy on July 4 and explained that I received this (refurbished) monitor about five months ago, and it already started malfunctioning. I was told that it could not be replaced because the replacement was a one-time courtesy; however, again, the monitor started doing this on its own, and it was only after less than five months that it started doing this. After doing a quick Google search to see if I could somehow troubleshoot/repair this on my own, it seems like this is a common issue that Eufy monitors have. While some people are able to resolve it, many people haven't been able to do so.

I'm not one to write negative reviews, but I want to write this to give a heads-up to other parents. The quality is so good, until it breaks... I just wish that Anker/Eufy provided a longer warranty or better solutions, especially since both the original and the replacement weren't used for very long until they broke. I'm extremely disappointed that Anker/Eufy is unwilling to replace this item, especially given the short time I used the original one as well as the replacement that they provided me

However, the cable connection to the camera is incredibly flimsy and can easily pop out if it's even slightly touched. The monitor on the other hand, leaves a bit more to be desired. It has the "cheap made in China" feel to it, and the buttons are clunky and cheap. When moving the camera with the monitor, there's a significant delay to the button presses, and if you're just trying to move the camera a little, you can easily overshoot and spend a lot of time trying to time how long you hold a button down and let go before it registers the movement and overshoots what you're trying to see. The cable connection to the monitor is wildly ineffective. If I don't wrap the cable around the monitor and position it just so, the cable will pop out of the monitor. Sometimes it won't even charge when the cable is plugged in, as it's very loose inside. I ended up just setting the cable aside and using a USB cable for a different product, which fit just fine. I would also point out that the monitor that came with the product originally stopped working, but upon telling this to Eufy, they quickly sent me a replacement monitor free of charge. They also threw in a free crib mount when we first received the item too. As I said, their customer service is excellent, which is why I gave back a star.

The second piece of this I'd like to point out is the actual alert system. There are two kinds of alerts, one that will turn the camera on from sleep if noise is detected, and another that will play an alarm if noise is detected. I like their idea of having these two separate alarms so that you don't have to be woken up by an alarm and a baby screaming, but there IS an alarm just in case you sleep through the baby crying. The downside of this though, is that the sensors are incredibly inconsistent. The camera monitors the sound levels in the room (indicated by a speaker icon and 5 dots along the top), and then transmits the levels to the monitor, which then reacts according to the alarms and sensor levels you set. However, there were nights where our baby was crying, and you can see the the camera registers no sound at all, causing it to never turn on (see attached video). Other nights nothing would be happening, and a car driving by outside would set the alarm off. It feels like the solution here is for the sensor to be much more sensitive, so at least it will catch your baby crying. Anything higher than a level 1, and I might as well not have a baby monitor at all. So now we just leave the baby monitor plugged in and turned on all night, and lay it face down on the bedside table to block the light from the monitor. It gets the job done so we've just dealt with it, but overall I'm very disappointed with it and wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

TLDR: I used this monitor for 3 years. Camera build is good quality, monitor feels cheap. Cable connections to camera and monitor are loose and cables fall out easily. Camera is inconsistent in picking up baby cries and often doesn't work as intended. Eufy has great customer service, but this is a weak product. Cannot recommend

I also got the second add on camera, but haven’t ever used it. Overall it does the job, but I’d say build quality and longevity are suspect

Antenna doesn’t stand up straight. This is a good baby monitor in theory but the one we got has a weak antenna that falls down instead of standing up straight. This dramatically weakens connection to the monitor. Very disappointing

Loud clicking noise!!!. The monitor makes a clicking sound when you check the handheld! I keep wondering why my son starts looking around the room the second I turn the handheld on to check on him! It’s because the camera on the monitor opens and closes or something! This is NOT worth a screaming baby!

Checking the Monitor Wakes Baby Up. I loved this monitor until I realized that every single time I check on my baby, it wakes her up. We would click the monitor screen on, and realize she would start moving every time.

The camera makes a very loud clicking sound when activated by the monitor. This one fault makes the camera unusable unless you just never click the monitor to check on baby.

Other problem I have - I routinely go out to my pool and bring the monitor while baby is sleeping. The signal works and I get good picture quality, but the sound stops working (still in range) and I can't get the sound to come back unless I reset the whole unit.

Other than those issues, the picture quality is great. I really do love the monitor, but I wish it didn't click

You can’t count on it, so I would count it out. There’s a lot to like about this camera. The app design is nice and has a neat feature where you can set the sound from the nursery to play in the background. The picture quality and night vision is good and I really like seeing the baby sleeping without having to go in the nursery and disturbing him.
However I want to throw it out the window. When it works it’s great, but that’s only 50% of the time. I am generally pretty patient with electronic issues but when it comes to a baby monitor I NEED it to be responsive, prompt, and consistent. Because realizing it quit working by hearing a very upset baby screaming feels like a parenting fail. I love this camera but since you can’t count on it I would count it out

Decent - But lacks durability. I've had this camera for 2.5 years now and have used it every single day since our kid was born. To address some of the other reviews: Night vision is ok - I can see in my daughter well but like all night vision, it's a black and white like picture. Not a problem if you ask me. We don't use the sound alert, so no comment there. The camera itself has been stable for us, no moving on its own or issues like that. Temperature sensor isn't accurate to the actual temperature, but it is shows relative temperature changes decently. With a smart thermostat, this isn't a major issue for me as I have other ways to check the temperature in my child's room.

The biggest issue I have with this camera, and the reason for only 2 stars - the handheld screen part lacks some durability, particularly in the antenna. The antenna has broken twice now in the exact same spot (by the word Eufy near the pivot point). The cracks are almost identical in their shape and how long they took to develop (~13 months). We never drop the camera, it sits on the counter away from our daughter, these are definitely stress cracks and show a lack of durability with the product. This wouldn't necessitate a 2-star rating by itself, except when contact about the issue, Eufy made us buy replacement for units for $60 each. All in, love the monitor for what it is, but is lacking durability that would be expected, especially in the baby market.

UPDATE: Eufy customer service says the crack is from daily use - as would be expected with a baby monitor - and I have to buy a new one from them

Turns off on itself. Not Reliable!!! I've had 2 nights with a newborn where this monitor TURNED OFF on itself during this night. My poor babe was screaming after 6hrs of not being fed due to this monitor not being on to alert me.  Luckily even with my lack of sleep I still have instincts to go check the baby on my own. What do i need to troubleshoot here to make sure it's on AND STAYS ON when i go to sleep??

Not durable. Really like this product. Good image, quality sound. Doesn’t need wifi. Biggest complaint is the durability of the monitor. A small drop and the screen no longer works. Still has sound but no image. Customer service had no options for trouble shooting nor had any resolution. For the price, I would expect a more durable monitor

Best features on the market. The customer support has been impeccable. Had issues with my first monitor and the replacement one with screen going black, battery not holding and signal loss after half a year or so. But Eufy went out of their way once the warranty was up to assist with issues. Have had my latest monitor for a few days and it really has all the features I’ve ever wanted in a baby monitoring system, which is why I’ve continued to return to them. I use it to watch over my 4 & 1.5 year old. At night it scans from one to the other room with ease and I’m the kind of mom who leaves the sound on all night even though it’s annoying so I don’t have much experience with the VOX or sleep mode. I love the size of the screen. We get great signal coverage throughout our 2 story 2k sq ft house. The resolution is great and I couldn’t go without the pan and tilt feature after having it with these cameras. Thank you Eufy!

Biggest disappointment. Honestly, I had high hopes for this camera since the sock is amazing, but over the last 2-3 weeks it has been AWFUL. It times out often, the sound has been going in and out, it’ll cancel notification settings randomly. The other day by base somehow “disconnected” although it was still plugged in and I had no monitor for a day (seems like no big deal
But we’re on two different floors and my room was sound proofed by the previous owners so at night I hear nothing). The app times out often... just overall has become a headache

First it was ok. Now - Unsatisfied.. This monitor is ok, but has to be in a very specific location to actually monitor the baby. It can’t just be in a corner near her crib. The limitation is in the cameras ability to rotate and move.

The other issue I have is that recently the monitor started to “blip” out and wouldn’t come on even when the sound was on. So - it’s useless. Now, just over a year after we got it, it’s just dead. Screen won’t light up.

Now I have to find something that actually works

Want to not actually montior baby while using a baby monitor? This one is for you!. Not sure what else there is to say, but it shuts off all the time, even when plugged in. I've literally watched my wife swaddle our baby in the crib and yet the unit didn't detect sound. Then it turned on automatically because it detected her finishing the swaddle, then shut back off as she was hovering over her and shushing her to sleep. It just stayed off. I could hear her shushing the baby (who was lightly crying) from two rooms away. This wasn't enough to trigger the auto-wake feature, regardless of the sensitivity setting.

As I'm writing this, she started crying, while crying, the unit turned off because it detected no sound. I can hear her across the house. It's garbage.

I've had the unit two days and already have proven, countless examples of how the baby is crying or moving and the monitor stays off, even when plugged in, not that plugging it in should matter.

There is no option to turn the "auto-turn off" feature off. These reviews of people praising is are from people who never bothered to test out the noise activation feature.

*UPDATE*

Found the option. It's called "Auto Wake Up" as in "automatically wakes up if you turn the screen off. What it really does, is it turns the Auto Wake AND Sleep function off altogether.

Which brings me to the second problem with makes it terrible: the battery. Lasts only a couple hours even when the sound is off and screen is fully dimmed. Most of the time we keep it plugged it while using it, but the problem is, the battery life never goes up if the unit is on. Smaller units have double the battery capacity and actually charge when they're plugged in and turned on

Got on 3/22 officially dead 3/31.  POC!. I bought this bc a coworker recommended it to me after our VAVA one died (it took some abuse from us dropping it numerous times).  This is our last kid so we didn’t want to invest in a fancy system.  I wanted something non-hackable and with its own handheld device so I didn’t have to worry about juggling between apps on our phones or babysitters having their phones charged etc.  worked great straight from the box,great pic, and the sound quality was great (which is good bc the other one was awful).  Then began having problems last week.  It would just turn off on its own when plugged in or fully charged and was unreliable.  Then yesterday it just crapped out.  Red light on the power cord side.  Sometimes a different color but it didn’t matter cord or not or charged how long, zero response from the power button.  I look at our baby monitor as a critical safety device as we have a 2.5 year okd whom is crawling out of his crib and bypassing baby gates etc.  to not have eyes and ears on him is absolutely stressing me out right now.  Barely slept last night trying to hear down the hall.  If you want reliable, this is not it.  We just wanted a simple, reliable work horse but got a Dud.  Makes me skeptical to try to exchange it and have the same failure early on

PASS!. I bought this for my daughter and I did not like it at all. Only one person can talk at a time. If I'm talking and she's talking....I can't hear her. The sound quality is horrible. There always a fuzzy sound. The monitors battery life is not long at all. Constantly have to charge it. The zoom is loud and it's distracting to my daughter.

The fuzzy..static sound is what I would say is a NO for me

This is loud and bright. If you are following Taking Cara Babies or any other sleep training that focuses on darkness, do not get this. It is really bright in a completely dark room due to the nightvision light at the bottom of the camera. And, the camera lens stays closed, so that it makes a noise so the camera lens can open whenever you turn it on. We have a hatch on the "tv" volume level 15-18%, if this means nothing to you - its equally loud to you standing in the shower. I can hear the camera lens clicking open/closed from OUTSIDE of our kid's bedroom door. Our hatch is on one side of the crib and this camera is on the other side (which is closer to the door)... but when I read people complaining about the noise level of the camera shutter, I never imagined it to be so loud. It will wake her up if she's not already awake when we turn it on - so its really a useless video monitor for checking-in

Good cameras, TERRIBLE monitor.. The cameras themselves and picture quality is acceptable but the monitor is terrible! We have to power it up twice in order to get it to turn on. I have infant twins the alarm on the monitor randomly goes off in the middle of the night whether there is a noise in the room or not. We have finally had to turn all of the sound alarms off and the speaker on the monitor just stays on so we can hear every chirp babies make. Even still with all the sound and notification alarms turned off the alarm will randomly go off when the monitor is on. It is beyond frustrating. If you want a baby monitor with a reliable alarm Do not purchase this one!!
Baby monitor. This is a Christmas present so I really can’t review it yet

Alert wakes you up more than your kid.... Everything about this product is really good except you can't turn off the stupid chime alert. My child rolls in bed everynow and then and it let's off a loud chime for anything waking us up unnessisarily multiple times a night. I spoke with their support team and they said there is no way to have this function like a normal monitor where you just have a live stream of the noise in your child's room. What a dumb feature. I can't return this fast enough

Great camera, nice screen, but lots of little problems that add up.. The Pros: The screen is big, the camera is great -- a big improvement over the fuzzy image and tiny screen from the Infant Optics monitor that this replaced.

The Cons: First, it's incredibly glitchy -- about 20% of the time, starting it up, it freezes and requires a hard reset by sticking a pin into the hole in the back.

Second, the rechargeable battery isn't replaceable, and nine months after buying it, we're already finding that it won't hold a charge. (And when it runs down, it emits an incredibly loud beep you can't turn off -- so loud that it can wake your kid in the next room.)

Third, it loses its signal incredibly easily -- as in, it'll be sitting on the table in our apartment and suddenly decide it can no longer find the camera that's 30 feet away in the next room. And when it loses its signal, it'll emit the same loud, piercing beep that it does when the battery is low -- a loud, child-waking beep you can't disable.

And fourth -- and this is minor, but irritating -- the kickstand on the back is incredibly tiny, which may not sound like a problem, but it makes it difficult to put it, e.g., on the arm of a sofa, or the edge of a bedside table.

All in all, we've only owned this monitor since February and are already replacing it, writing it off as a sleek, expensive mistake
Definitely not refurbished in any way. Very broken.. Last time I’ll buy refurbished on Amazon. Right out of the box the baby monitor started screeching and making horrible noises. Instant return

Bad, sluggish interface and annoying echo. The interface for this thing is sluggish and confusing. It's packed with options, but I only ever want to toggle a few of them. Nevertheless I have to click through a ton of menus each time which is slow.

The most annoying party though, is the small lag for sound. If you're near enough to hear the baby without the monitor, it gives the cry a horrible jarring echo. I leave it muted and use it as a video monitor only, since it sounds so annoying

Worked great for about a year, then audio issues. This camera worked great for a little over a year, then the audio went out. Started with random loud static that will wake you up in the middle of the night. And now there’s just constant static and we can’t hear anything in the kids room

Worked great for about a year, then audio issues. This camera worked great for a little over a year, then the audio went out. Started with random loud static that will wake you up in the middle of the night. And now there’s just constant static and we can’t hear anything in the kids room

The good and the bad. The picture and video on the monitor or fine. The problem is the alarm system. Sometimes when a plane flies over the alarm goes off which wakes me and my wife up. Others time our child can be screaming at the top of his lungs and the alarm will never go off. The camera is good but the microphone is terrible. Right now I can hear my child screaming upstairs but the alarm is not going off. When my wife walked back downstairs the squeak of a stair set off the alarm. This item is too inconsistent to rely on

No longer functional after one year. We read Wirecutter's review and decided to go with this monitor over one year ago. We thought baby monitor was adequate when we first got it. The picture quality and talk-back function were impressive. However, we noticed that each time we awakened/lit up the screen to check on our baby, it'd make a loud click noise on the camera end and it'd almost always startle our daughter - even with her white noise machine going. Just what we were hoping NOT to do. We got used to that and rarely checked on her if we didn't hear her, however, about one month ago, one year after our original purchase, the monitor sound function stopped working if the screen had gone to sleep mode. So, while the monitor screen was turned ON but dimmed such as overnight, the sound of our daughter crying couldn't be heard on the monitor at ALL. We made sure it wasn't a charging or volume issue - it was charged just fine with the volume up as usual - but nothing. Needless to say, we're disappointed with the monitor and will be changing to a different brand for baby #2

Camera sounds have terrified my toddler. This is our third camera. The one we had most recently was cheaper and the second camera never connected to the monitor. So, we thought it would be time to invest in a nicer camera to see if we could get better results.

I want to love this camera. The image is great. Being able to rotate the camera is great. Unfortunately, the sound quality is strange; The volume has to be nearly all the way up to hear what is my toddler is saying.

Most importantly, as many other reviews noted, upon receipt, the camera made noises when going to sleep. A quick call to tech support got us updated, assured it would stop. However, the camera ALSO clicks when it turns to/from night mode. I suspect it clicks when the monitor turns on or turns off sleep mode based on my kid's same-time freak outs, but I haven't been able to confirm it. There is no way to stop it. My toddler is now terrified of being in her room.

I have initiated a return with Amazon and switched back to the old camera we had and will either contact their support to try to fix the additional camera or order another version our very first Hello Baby camera, which was much superior in sound quality, VOX, range, and silent camera functioning, which matter the most. Picture quality is a nice bonus, but not at the expense of usability

Want to like it, but I HATE it.. Man I want to love this monitor. Here are some pros:

1. Great picture quality! Night camera is great.
2. It looks nice and feels like a quality product.

Cons:
1. The camera is LOUD when it’s working to focus. If my child is sleeping lightly, it wakes him up. This is BEYOND frustrating, especially when it ends bedtime or nap time early. We’ll be buying a different product for this reason alone because we simply cannot have the baby monitor ending nap times early or waking our toddler up early in the morning. It’s just not okay.

2. It has a very small range and constantly disconnects, which sends off an alarm and wakes us up. My cheap video monitor has a better range than this one. And waking up to a monitor beeping at me simply because it can’t find the camera is about as obnoxious as nap time ending early. Once the monitor is about 20 feet away from the room, it disconnects randomly and constantly. Seems like this is a crazy short range.

3. It will just decide on its own to flip to the other camera - we have dual cameras set up on this. So sometimes I won’t hear that my child is up, because it’s not on the correct camera. This really isn’t okay with me. If I wanted to see the other camera, I’d toggle it myself thank you.

I’d either save your money and get a cheaper product that will work just as well, if not better, or spend extra money and get a superior product that this camera is supposedly competing with. I wish we were inside the return window on this, but we’re not so we’ll just have to eat the cost and try to find something better

Decent but fragile. The battery life was great and the picture was decent enough, but I’ve had two of these monitors now that have taken exactly one fall off of the couch. In the first case, the fall damaged one of the volume buttons so I was no longer able to control the volume.

No big deal really because we were having another kid so we needed another camera. We opted for the camera/monitor pack again rather than just an additional camera.

Five months later, the monitor fell about two feet off the couch onto the floor (hardwood with a rug over top of it). This time, the power button broke in exactly the same manner as the volume button with the first monitor.

It’s really disappointing that a simple fall was enough to render the monitor useless. I get it, it fell onto a hard surface and this is the result, but I’d hope a baby monitor would be able to withstand a little bit of punishment (ya know, on account of kids).

I don’t see an option to buy just a monitor so now we have to drop more money than we’d like and end up with an extra camera that we don’t need

Seems good at first, but somewhat limited with poor execution and poor customer service. At first, it seems like this is a pretty good baby monitor.  Easy to switch between cameras, easy to setup, and image quality is decent.  However, the sound detection, customizability of alerts, false positives, and lack of white noise detection/elimination seems like pretty glaring omissions.  Customer service/tech support was completely unhelpful and did not seem willing or interested in helping solve some questions/problems we have with the system

From bad to worse. Started out functional, however with the occasional freezing audio and visual others have mentioned. Have been using for about a month and noticed the screen started to get really dark and with fleeting vertical “bars” across the screen. Despite turning on and off night mode and the entire monitor itself (which used to “fix” the problem/clarity at least temporarily), now the best view is as pictured above...aka useless and dark (despite use in a room with complete daylight at time of picture). Very disappointed and don’t understand how their are such positive reviews

Decent but with a flaw that could be a deal-breaker for some. This baby monitor is almost very good but has a consistent problem where the VOX mode does not activate / alert when the baby is crying. Other than that, this monitor would easily be 4-stars and possibly 5.

Here is some more detail: VOX mode allows you to turn off the screen, and then the monitor will turn on when there is sound above a user-configured threshold. Eufy’s documentation says that the noise has to be for longer than a half-second to trigger, but we constantly have times where our baby cries and it doesn’t trigger. Sometimes it is very short — like just a single cry and then silence so in those cases I would accept Eufy’s explanation. But a lot of times the baby will be actively and continuously crying and the monitor will not come on. In fact, what prompted me to write this review is that my baby was crying for around 5 seconds and I could clearly hear him from the living room but the monitor didn’t come on.

Other than that I have no serious complaints

Do not buy this monitor. This monitor is terrible. First of all it was incredibly difficult to install in order to get a full picture of the crib. They say you can pan the entire room and that is just not true. We had to build our own contraption to get this monitor to give us the view we wanted. Just of the crib and we still can’t get the full crib. My sister has this monitor and had the same problems. Second, it does not alert you as it should. Sometimes my little one will be crying and the monitor will not even go off. Invest in a monitor with movement and sound alerts instead. Also, the camera itself makes a terrible clicking noise every time it does pick up noise and kicks the monitor on. It has woken our baby up multiple times. Lastly, sometimes the screen stays black for no reason. You will hear the baby cry with no visual of the baby. Which defeats the purpose of even having a monitor at all

Terrible baby monitor that wakes your kids up and dies after a few months use. CONS:
1. If you use VOX mode so the monitor is not on all night with more than one children, it will only activate to the noise the camera is set on. I found this out the hard way when my toddler was crying for who knows how long because the camera was set on my baby's room.
2. Night vision is meh. Not really different than any other camera out there
3. The cameras make a clicking noise when they activate, especially when switching from daytime to night vision, like if the lights have been turned off. Updates were supposed to fix this but they still make the noise. It wakes my children up, so I often don't turn the monitor on to check if they are awake yet because I am afraid it will wake them up. Kind of defeats the purpose of a baby monitor.
4. Our parent monitor died after 7 months of use when it started flickering uncontrollably one morning and the screen went very dim. It is unusable now, maybe as a sound monitor, but not as a baby monitor.
5. It's a very expensive monitor to have all these terrible flaws.
6. Controls for changing sound and things are clunky. It's annoying to have to activate the monitor before pressing the volume controls up or down to make sure the volume is turned up for monitoring.

PROS:
1. Day vision is good if you happen to have your children nap with lights on. We don't, but maybe some do.
2. Nice big screen
3. Good customer service, but they can only help you if you are in the US

Voice activation did not work. The picture quality on this monitor is great, if you just need to keep an eye on your kids, this is a great monitor to choose. With that being said, we have an infant and anytime we would put him up in the upstairs to nap, we would have to obsessively check the monitor, because for some reason the noise would not trip the monitor to come on. More than one time I would check the monitor and see my baby screaming and turning purple and that is absolutely not acceptable. There is no option to just have sound all the time, you have to turn on a voice activation setting and it just did not work. I cannot even describe the rage and emotion it would cause me to realize my baby was screaming and I couldn’t hear him - thank goodness I realized the setting wasn’t working quickly, so it only happened a couple of times - but it is frustrating to spend $160 on some thing for it not to work as intended

Poor quality and terrible customer service.. I purchased this monitor because of the appealing features...picture quality, temperature, time display, and ability to have 2 cameras synced to one monitor. Unfortunately, I DO NOT recommend this poor quality product. I’ve had countless issues with random beeping (when all alerts and sounds are off that kept waking up is on the middle of the night), unreliable temperature readings, monitor blanking and sound being gone when the picture reappears, Mini usb cord that inserts to back of camera falling out, night vision display being too dark for one camera (even on brightest setting) when fine for other camera. What makes it worse is their customer service. They reply to their email once every 24 hours. Quite frustrating, especially when they offer trouble shooting ideas, software updates etc that you’ve already tried and they’ve recommended. It’s as if they disregard any previous communication. I’ve been through 3 monitors, which I’ve completed resets and softwares updates. The last replacement monitor had the same issue (random beeping). They asked me to do another software update. When the issue was not resolved, the manager said she could not make any more exceptions (I asked they send me a replacement first before I ship mine back so I am not without one) because it would be unfair for other customers. I’m not quite sure how resolving my issues impact other customer. Save yourself the headache and try a different product...or at least go with a company with good customer service that will stand by their product

Promising, but downhill fast. The monitor does a lot of things well, but the lack of durability and speed at which the product began to completely breakdown on us after a short period of moderate use ultimately means we can’t recommend. Certainly does not hold up anywhere near as well as one would expect for the price.

First, the positives:

* Picture quality is good, and the big screen is nice
* Sound and alerts are fine
* Night vision works pretty well
* Ability to adjust camera remotely is helpful
* Decent range

Cons:

* The battery is terrible. It was decent for about 3 weeks, and after that it does not hold a charge at all. Have to have the unit plugged in for it to function. However...
* After a couple months of use plugged in, the power plug on the monitor became incredibly sensitive and finicky. It has to be held just-so for it to stay engaged and providing power to the screen, which is very irritating since the battery doesn’t work either. So you let your guard down and it shifts and the whole thing shuts off.
* The bright light on the front of the camera is bad. We have to cover it to keep it from waking up the kid.
* Temperature appears to essentially be a random number generator.
* The camera stand just...broke randomly. It was there, holding the camera, and then it just snapped and the camera fell. Shoddy.

Overall, while this was a pretty promising monitor at first, the poor build quality and the rapid failure of vital components under moderate use conditions means we don’t recommend, especially at this relatively high price for a baby monitor

Malfunctioning alert. I loved this monitor but am upset because the alert sometimes works and sometimes doesn’t. My baby was screaming for who knows how long and it never went off. Luckily I heard it and found her sweaty, crying and upset. Super annoyed that this monitor did not go off. Checked everything and it was all set correctly. It’s done this multiple times making the monitor useless

All around poor baby monitor. I wanted to like this monitor so bad, but I can't think of anything nice  to say about it. If your baby sleeps/naps in a dark room with a noise  machine, you will have the same issues I did. The night vision was garbage and so were the alert features (VOX and sound alarms). I bought this for my newborn, so its a different level of monitoring at that age. I tried it out in  my 2 year old's room and it was *fine* but still not better than the one  we currently use. Maybe I  am  too  critical because  I have hated nearly every monitor I have purchased

Broken 3 days in. Returning- 3 days in and the sound on the parent monitor stopped working. Several other reviews also mentioned the loud click that wakes the baby when it comes out of sleep mode and camera turns on- it did in fact wake my baby to the point that I had to turn off the sleep mode. Picture is clear, but if the sounds doesn’t work, it’s pretty useless

Works great --- when it's connected. I bought this camera set because my old set would often lose connectivity. At first, I would have written a five star review for this. It has a great picture and a decent range and battery life. I didn't use the white noise or talk back/music functions, but they work fine... I just didn't need them. What I DID need was for this unit to work all night. I'll be in the very next room and it will randomly lose connection. This causes the parent unit to beep, which is annoying to wake up to. It's not like we have a big house (we live in a small apartment). Really disappointing...seems like every baby monitor has this issue

Monitor wakes baby up!. I liked the look of this product because it was modern and had a nice big screen.

However, after a while I noticed that every time I checked the receiver the baby would stir. Sure enough we tested it and the monitor makes a click noise when the receiver is turned on and another click noise when it goes into sleep mode.

Look elsewhere. We are returning this ASAP

Disappointed. Most defective product ever. At first, after following all the startup instructions the monitor was stuck on the start up screen and wouldn’t respond to any buttons, even holding the power button. After sitting stuck for about 30min realized there was a reset button hidden under the kickstand. That made it work...for a while. After about an hour of running the camera I turned on the monitor to find the screen all green tinted and glitching, only button that worked was the power button but it always reloaded to a green screen and shut itself off in less than a minute when the auto off setting was on the highest. Gave up on the whole thing at that point, packaged it back up and returned.

Never got to test night vision since it didn’t make it that long. In the short time it was working the picture was decent, movement responsive, sound good in both directions, lullabies were nice and noise alarm worked. Only thing I didn’t like was that pushing any of the buttons cut out the sound coming through the monitor so you can’t hear anything while you’re moving the camera, and the antenna doesn’t lock into the up position so it flops around

Not as good as I thought it would be.. The picture is good and the features are nice. However- I can not hear my daughter when she wakes up. I’ve unplugged, re synced, turned the volume up.  Basically I have to have the monitor up to my ear to hear any movement. I got this as a gift last year for our baby shower. I just opened it because my baby is finally sleeping in her own room. It’s disappointing that I’m going to have to purchase a new baby monitor

No sound alert at all. Tried 3 units already. Got help from technical support, make sure the set up was correct. All the 3 baby monitors never make any sound alert, even I clapped hands in front of the camera. Will return, won’t try another replacement

Click when you turn on wakes up my baby. I wanted to love this baby monitor. I think I’ve tried just about every non-WiFi baby monitor on the market. I was finally deciding between this one and the Vava- but ultimately decided on the Eufy because the Vava has this very annoying bright yellow/green light that made my baby’s room lit up so she couldn’t sleep. I thought I made the right choice until...every single time I turn the monitor on to look at my baby she WAKES UP! I thought I must be going crazy until one day my husband was looking at the monitor when I was in the room and I heard a CLICK! He did it again and CLICK. THIS BABY MONITOR CLICKS EVERY TIME YOU TURN IT ON! I’m not sure if it’s a major glitch in my unit- the return date is passed so I’m stuck with it- or if other moms are having this issue too. The good things about this baby monitor is that it is very easy to setup which has been amazing to work with when traveling with an infant. To grandparents houses, vacations, or just setting up at home. The range is also really good. In fact it worked across 3 hotel rooms (my folks in law baby sat our son while we attended my cousins wedding at a hotel).

The annoying things are that Eufy has many firmware updates for this device, and with no wifi connection it requires manual intervention to update the firmware. But for some the disconnect from the internet could be a selling point!

The part that ultimately has provoked me.towrire a review was how easily the device became obsolete by a small drop from my 10mth old son on our kitchen floor. Now the monitors screen only shows a black image (clearly no feed to it), yet continues to give audio. So at best it is now a nighlight for when my son cries at night... But when his nursery is next door to our room that's not super helpful.

So I'm summary, if you like a tech savvy baby monitor this can fit the bill, it offers RF tech for the security minded, and when used in daylight (for naps) can give pretty good image quality. But be warned it cannot survive normal abuse from an Infant (let alone a toddler!). So if you travel a lot I would recommend this for easy setup, but it's durability and ability to be updated by the average Joe might make it a poor choait for the average consumer

Undependable!. I wanted to love this monitor bc we love the eufy brand, but just couldn't trust it to work accurately all the time and had to return it. Here's my experience:
I set it up at naptime and it worked great! Monitor turned off and on when he made noise, screen quality was great... No issues.
That same evening it was like a different monitor! Suddenly (without changing any thing in his room or on the monitor) the camera unit was reading my son's white noise machine as a level 3 on the noise scale. This caused the monitor to constantly turn on and off which also caused the camera unit to turn on and off in my son's room. When it does that, it makes a fairly loud clicking sound, which started waking up my son bc it was happening every 15-30 seconds. (Obviously his sound machine wasn't that loud.)
I adjusted the sensitivity level to volume 4 (one level up), and it stopped turning off and on constantly. Reliable monitoring is the main point of these systems! You can have all the bells and whistles, amazing picture quality, or even HD sound... But if it doesn't reliably tell me when my child wakes up screaming, it's worthless!
